verdict.candidate: S2 CCBS16 destination-owned bounded block suppression
verdict.priority: retain as the sole new lossy candidate, behind closure of admitted exact C1/C2/C3 hardware
verdict.current_action: obtain the exact missing data and run one precommitted paired AEE plus same-resource address-timed experiment
verdict.reason: M1575 proves activity-relative decoder block eligibility only. It has neither paired optical-flow accuracy nor executable bank/burst cycle evidence.

first_principles_findings.evidence: At epsilon=0.1 M1575 reports 30.168202% decoder block eligibility and 29.930345% hypothetical INT8 weight-byte eligibility, while cycles/traffic/speedup are all false.
first_principles_findings.impact: Fixed issue, metadata, burst alignment, cache reuse, ports, psum and commit can consume the apparent saving. The 30.168% number cannot be translated into 1.432x.

first_principles_findings.evidence: The exact epsilon=0 arm already has 21.999322% weight eligibility; epsilon=0.1 adds only 7.931024 percentage points. Epsilon=0.02 adds only 2.889266 points.
first_principles_findings.impact: The experiment must compare each arm with the exact physical baseline and separately report the marginal benefit of loss, rather than credit all epsilon=0.1 eligibility to approximation.

first_principles_findings.evidence: The sealed M1575 population is 30 samples x four decoder ConvTranspose layers and its claim boundary sets decoder_only=true.
first_principles_findings.impact: M1575 supplies no FC or patch-embed evidence. Its compute object is disjoint from C1's four bottleneck Conv3x3 layers, so local ratios may not be multiplied.

first_principles_findings.evidence: All 40 event tensors are present and match the final capture hashes, but only the ten zurich_city_09_a GT tensors and valid masks are local. Thirty GT tensors and thirty masks are absent.
first_principles_findings.impact: No complete same-40 paired AEE or per-sequence gate can be executed locally without importing the missing 60 files or running on the data server.

first_principles_findings.evidence: M1575 has no cycles/traffic; the compact decoder scheduler authority is design/source-only; M1575 computes FP32 M(G,O) while its byte proxy assumes packed INT8.
first_principles_findings.impact: The O16 bank/burst layout, all metadata/debt charges, 40-sample decoder payload, and conservative fixed-point bound must be frozen before any RTL is justified.

scope_decision.fc_patch_extension: NO_EVIDENCE; requires new retained payload, metadata and paired baseline
scope_decision.shared_fabric_rule: charge C2 K8, Acc24, weight/psum ports, metadata/debt and completion under one address-timed schedule
scope_decision.composition_rule: sum measured operator cycles in a unified replay; never multiply C1 and S2 local ratios

precommitted_experiment.population: the exact ordered ep34 40-sample final-capture population
precommitted_experiment.accuracy_gate: epsilon=0 bit-exact; for a lossy arm overall valid-pixel-weighted DeltaAEE<=0.02 and every-sequence DeltaAEE<=0.03
precommitted_experiment.cycle_gate: the same arm achieves ratio-of-sums local decoder speedup>=1.15x versus the strongest exact BIT_TYPED_K8 baseline on the identical resource/bank/burst model
precommitted_experiment.rtl_gate: all accuracy, cycle, O16 physical suppression, metadata/debt charge, 40-sample and fixed-point quantization conditions pass
precommitted_experiment.failure_action: NO_GO_RTL; retain only as an offline eligibility/appendix result

exact_missing_handoff.baseline_and_candidate_predictions: unpruned, epsilon=0, epsilon=0.02 and epsilon=0.1 for all 40 samples
exact_missing_handoff.decoder_payload: D0-D3 retained payload/decisions for the ten zurich_city_09_a samples, so address timing also uses 40/40
exact_missing_handoff.quantization: deployed decoder fixed-point weights/scales, conservative integer M(G,O), metadata width and saturation
exact_missing_handoff.memory_mapping: O16 physical bank rows and external burst addresses plus the same-layout exact baseline
